PFI2-001 · 这篇PFI打浆论文研究的是哪两类纸浆？原料是否经过漂白，采用什么制浆方法？

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

研究使用两类纸浆：漂白针叶木硫酸盐浆和漂白阔叶木硫酸盐浆。 [1]
所用原料为商业漂白浆，即经过漂白处理。 [1]
制浆方法为硫酸盐法（kraft pulping）。 [1]

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining\n[原文]\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. PFI2-004 · PFI打到12000转的时候，针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的打浆度各是多少？那我们以后想要63 °SR左右的浆，是不是直接打12000转就行了？

审校状态：revised；修正“同一条件下”的不准确表述，事实与引用组更严谨；但作用力差异只写进审校问题说明，没有进入显示的回答，必答P3仍为0.5。

参考答案与必答要点
方法部分给出的12000转对应针叶木63 °SR、阔叶木57 °SR。相同转数在本文不同浆种/条件下得到的打浆度不同，不能据此建立适用于所有纸浆的唯一换算。两类浆的作用力也不同，不能把差异全部归因于浆种。

DeepSeek原稿

按文中0、4000、8000、12000、16000转对应的打浆度序列，12000转时针叶木浆为63 °SR。 [1]
同一条件下，12000转时阔叶木浆为57 °SR。 [1]
因此想要约63 °SR的浆，不能对针叶木浆和阔叶木浆都直接固定打12000转；针叶木浆在12000转可达63 °SR，而阔叶木浆在12000转仅57 °SR，需要提高转数。 [1]
原文只给出阔叶木浆12000转为57 °SR、16000转为70 °SR，未给出达到63 °SR所需的确切转数，且这些数值仅适用于该文的浆料与PFI条件。 [1]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

DeepSeek审校后

按文中0、4000、8000、12000、16000转对应的打浆度序列，12000转时针叶木浆为63 °SR。 [1]
在该文阔叶木浆的PFI条件下，12000转时打浆度为57 °SR。 [1]
因此想要约63 °SR的浆，不能对针叶木浆和阔叶木浆都直接固定打12000转；针叶木浆在12000转可达63 °SR，而阔叶木浆在12000转仅57 °SR，需要提高转数。 [1]
原文只给出阔叶木浆12000转为57 °SR、16000转为70 °SR，未给出达到63 °SR所需的确切转数，且这些数值仅适用于该文的浆料与PFI条件。 [1]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.1. PFI Refining\n[原文]\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",

PFI2-006 · WRV在本文中如何测定和计算？请解释公式中两个质量的含义。

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
按ISO 23714使用0.5 g绝干样品测定。WRV=(m1−m2)/m2×100%，m1为离心后样品质量，m2为烘干样品质量。

DeepSeek原稿

WRV 按 ISO 23714 测定，所用试样为 0.5 g（o.d.，绝干计）。 [2]
WRV 的计算公式为 WRV(%) = (m1 − m2)/m2 × 100%。 [1]
公式中的 m1 是离心后试样的质量（即含水试样质量）。 [2]
公式中的 m2 是烘干试样的质量（绝干质量）。 [2]
m1 与 m2 之差对应试样经离心后仍保持的水的质量，因此该比值表示每单位绝干质量所保持的水量。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

DeepSeek审校后

WRV 按 ISO 23714 测定，所用试样为 0.5 g（o.d.，绝干计）。 [2]
WRV 的计算公式为 WRV(%) = (m1 − m2)/m2 × 100%。 [1]
公式中的 m1 是离心后试样的质量（即含水试样质量）。 [2]
公式中的 m2 是烘干试样的质量（绝干质量）。 [2]
m1 与 m2 之差对应试样经离心后仍保持的水的质量，因此该比值表示每单位绝干质量所保持的水量。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

PFI2-007 · CI-XI与CI-XA有什么区别？请给出本文CI-XI的公式，并说明CI-XA依据什么计算。

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
CI-XI用衍射峰强度计算：(I200−Iam)/I200×100%。CI-XA用晶区峰面积占总衍射面积的百分比计算，来自峰拟合。两者采用不同口径。

DeepSeek原稿

本文中两类CI值分别由峰强度法（CI-XI）和峰拟合（CI-XA）获得。 [2]
本文CI-XI的计算公式为 CI-XI = (I200 − Iam)/I200 × 100%。 [2]
公式中I200是2θ=22°–23°之间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam是2θ=18°–19°之间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [2]
CI-XA等于结晶峰面积占整个衍射图谱总面积的百分比，其分析中基线校正后的衍射图用Pearson VII函数进行解卷积。 [2]
Figure 4的图注将CI-XI定义为比较XRD峰强度得到的结晶度指数，将CI-XA定义为比较XRD峰面积得到的结晶度指数。 [4]
Table 1的脚注同样说明CI-XI由衍射强度之比获得，CI-XA由峰面积之比获得。 [1]
文中指出CI-XI值明显高于CI-XA，可能是由于CI-XA分析中无定形贡献被过拟合。 [3]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

DeepSeek审校后

本文中两类CI值分别由峰强度法（CI-XI）和峰拟合（CI-XA）获得。 [2]
本文CI-XI的计算公式为 CI-XI = (I200 − Iam)/I200 × 100%。 [2]
公式中I200是2θ=22°–23°之间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam是2θ=18°–19°之间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [2]
CI-XA等于结晶峰面积占整个衍射图谱总面积的百分比，其分析中基线校正后的衍射图用Pearson VII函数进行解卷积。 [2]
Figure 4的图注将CI-XI定义为比较XRD峰强度得到的结晶度指数，将CI-XA定义为比较XRD峰面积得到的结晶度指数。 [4]
Table 1的脚注同样说明CI-XI由衍射强度之比获得，CI-XA由峰面积之比获得。 [1]
文中指出CI-XI值明显高于CI-XA，可能是由于CI-XA分析中无定形贡献被过拟合。 [3]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

PFI2-010 · 打浆前后，两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸是怎么变的？从不打浆到16000转分别是多少？

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
针叶木和阔叶木均从4.5 nm变为4.7 nm。这里是晶粒尺寸，不是纤维长度。

DeepSeek原稿

两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆过程中总体呈上升趋势。 [2]
针叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维在16000转时垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸较12000转时的4.8 nm略降至4.7 nm。 [1]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

DeepSeek审校后

两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆过程中总体呈上升趋势。 [2]
针叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维从不打浆到16000转，垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm。 [1]
阔叶木纤维在16000转时垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸较12000转时的4.8 nm略降至4.7 nm。 [1]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

PFI2-011 · 是不是打浆转数越高，纤维素结晶度就越低？

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
不是单调下降。针叶木CI-XI从4000转70.42%升到8000转72.54%；阔叶木也从73.01%升到75.06%。0转到16000转总体下降，但过程中先降、回升、再降。

DeepSeek原稿

关于PFI精磨对纤维素结晶度的影响，已有研究结论并不一致，并未确认结晶度会随打浆程度提高而单调降低。 [1]
本研究中软木浆和硬木浆的CI-XI与CI-XA随PFI打浆转数总体呈先下降、后上升、再下降的波动趋势。 [2]
软木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为40.46%、37.71%、39.65%、36.22%和34.20%，显示4,000转下降后8,000转回升。 [4]
硬木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为47.16%、36.26%、42.35%、39.21%和38.01%，同样不是单调下降。 [4]
因此，打浆转数提高在本研究中使16,000转的结晶度指数低于未打浆，但中间存在回升，不能概括为转数越高结晶度越低。 [2] [4]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

DeepSeek审校后

关于PFI精磨对纤维素结晶度的影响，已有研究结论并不一致，并未确认结晶度会随打浆程度提高而单调降低。 [1]
本研究中软木浆和硬木浆的CI-XI与CI-XA随PFI打浆转数总体呈先下降、后上升、再下降的波动趋势。 [2]
软木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为40.46%、37.71%、39.65%、36.22%和34.20%，显示4,000转下降后8,000转回升。 [4]
硬木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为47.16%、36.26%、42.35%、39.21%和38.01%，同样不是单调下降。 [4]
因此，打浆转数提高在本研究中使16,000转的结晶度指数低于未打浆，但中间存在回升，不能概括为转数越高结晶度越低。 [2] [4]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

    "answer": "关于PFI精磨对纤维素结晶度的影响，已有研究结论并不一致，并未确认结晶度会随打浆程度提高而单调降低。 [1]\n本研究中软木浆和硬木浆的CI-XI与CI-XA随PFI打浆转数总体呈先下降、后上升、再下降的波动趋势。 [2]\n软木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为40.46%、37.71%、39.65%、36.22%和34.20%，显示4,000转下降后8,000转回升。 [4]\n硬木浆的CI-XA在0、4,000、8,000、12,000和16,000转时分别为47.16%、36.26%、42.35%、39.21%和38.01%，同样不是单调下降。 [4]\n因此，打浆转数提高在本研究中使16,000转的结晶度指数低于未打浆，但中间存在回升，不能概括为转数越高结晶度越低。 [2] [4]",

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

PFI2-012 · 本文CI-XI和CI-XA的大小关系如何？两种方法的结果相关吗？请分别给出两类浆的相关系数及显著性。

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
CI-XI明显高于CI-XA。两者显著正相关：针叶木r=0.919，阔叶木r=0.925，均p<0.05。这一对相关系数对应两个结晶度指标，不能与氢键含量—CI的相关系数混用。

DeepSeek原稿

表1中各精磨转数下CI-XI均高于CI-XA，原文也指出CI-XI显著高于CI-XA。 [1] [2]
CI-XI高于CI-XA可能与CI-XA分析中非晶贡献过拟合有关。 [1]
CI-XI与CI-XA在软木纤维和硬木纤维中均显著相关。 [1]
软木纤维的CI-XI与CI-XA相关系数为0.919（p < 0.05）。 [1]
硬木纤维的CI-XI与CI-XA相关系数为0.925（p < 0.05）。 [1]

PFI2-013 · PFI打浆过程中结晶度为什么会先降、再升、再降？

审校状态：revised；在额外机制说明中补回作者推测语气；相关系数及原有核心要点不变。本轮不把更谨慎的表述自动当成新增要点收益。

参考答案与必答要点
作者提出：早期可能主要作用于晶区使CI下降；随后对无定形区的作用以及干燥时可能的共结晶使CI回升；后期晶区继续破坏使CI再降。原文使用可能、可以解释等措辞，属于作者的机制解释，不是排除其他机制后的唯一因果证明。

DeepSeek原稿

两种浆的CI-XI和CI-XA随PFI打浆均呈先下降、再上升、随后下降的相似波动趋势。 [2] [4]
第一阶段的结晶度下降表明，PFI机械处理可能主要作用于纤维素的结晶区。 [2]
随后的结晶度上升可解释为更强的机械力作用于无定形区，并在PFI的机械和热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。 [2]
最后的结晶度下降可能是结晶区被持续破坏所致。 [2]
CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量的变化趋势相似且显著相关（软木纤维0.912、硬木纤维0.889，p<0.05），而结晶区该氢键含量高于无定形区。 [3]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

      "text": "随后的结晶度上升可解释为更强的机械力作用于无定形区，并在PFI的机械和热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the different regions of cellulose. DeepSeek审校后

两种浆的CI-XI和CI-XA随PFI打浆均呈先下降、再上升、随后下降的相似波动趋势。 [2] [4]
第一阶段的结晶度下降表明，PFI机械处理可能主要作用于纤维素的结晶区。 [2]
随后的结晶度上升可解释为更强的机械力作用于无定形区，并在PFI的机械和热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。 [2]
最后的结晶度下降可能是结晶区被持续破坏所致。 [2]
CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量的变化趋势相似且显著相关（软木纤维0.912、硬木纤维0.889，p<0.05）；作者推测结晶区该氢键含量可能高于无定形区。 [3]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

PFI2-014 · 按照作者的解释，PFI打浆为什么会提高WRV，又如何与纤维间结合联系起来？

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
打浆促进细纤维化，产生新的表面和更多孔隙，使WRV及纤维膨胀提高；纤维横向更柔顺，有助于改善纤维网络中的纤维间结合。这是本文提出的解释链条，不能据此给出每一步的独立因果效应大小。

DeepSeek原稿

PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀）、外部细纤维化、纤维切断和细小组分形成，并提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]
作者将打浆度和WRV随PFI转数增加而显著增加归因于更高程度的细纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [2]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
在分子层面，PFI的机械作用可能使纤维素分子链断裂，减少O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键，并与内部和外部细纤维化密切相关。 [1]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶指数会通过提高分子链运动性、可及性和WRV来进一步提高纤维素纤维的柔性。 [1] [4]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

The main effects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [ 1 ]. These effects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. DeepSeek审校后

PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀）、外部细纤维化、纤维切断和细小组分形成，并提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]
作者将打浆度和WRV随PFI转数增加而显著增加归因于更高程度的细纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [2]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
在分子层面，PFI的机械作用可能使纤维素分子链断裂，减少O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键，并与内部和外部细纤维化密切相关。 [1]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶指数会通过提高分子链运动性、可及性和WRV来进一步提高纤维素纤维的柔性。 [1] [4]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

    "answer": "PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀）、外部细纤维化、纤维切断和细小组分形成，并提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]\n作者将打浆度和WRV随PFI转数增加而显著增加归因于更高程度的细纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [2]\nWRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]\n在分子层面，PFI的机械作用可能使纤维素分子链断裂，减少O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键，并与内部和外部细纤维化密切相关。 [1]\n较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶指数会通过提高分子链运动性、可及性和WRV来进一步提高纤维素纤维的柔性。 [1] [4]",

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nFor the content of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the trend can be <sup>For</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>content</sup> <sup>of</sup> <sup>O(6)H O(3′)</sup> <sup>inter-molecular</sup> <sup>H-bonds</sup> <sup>of</sup> <sup>softwood</sup> <sup>fiber,</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>trend</sup> <sup>can</sup> <sup>be</sup>divided into two stages, as shown in Table 2a. It decreased by 7.72% from 28.23% to 26.05% as refining from 0r to 4000 r and then increased by 9.14% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by a decrease of 17.13%, with the revolutions increasing from 8000 r to 16,000 r. Regarding the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds of <sup>with</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>revolutions</sup> <sup>increasing</sup> <sup>from</sup> <sup>8000</sup> <sup>r</sup> <sup>to</sup> <sup>16,000</sup> <sup>r.</sup> <sup>Regarding</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>O(6)H O(3′)</sup> <sup>H-bonds</sup> <sup>of</sup>hardwood fiber, the trend was almost similar to that of softwood fibers, except for a small increase of 0.45% from 8000 r to 12,000 r (in Table 2b).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively.     "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

从 Figure 1 近似读取，针叶木的平均长度加权纤维长度由约2000 μm降至约1600 μm，阔叶木约900 μm且基本持平。 [1]
文献将阔叶木纤维相关参数无显著变化归因于其打浆时施加的较低 refining pressure。 [1]
方法中每单位棒长作用力为3.33 N/mm（针叶木）和1.77 N/mm（阔叶木）。 [5]

It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. DeepSeek审校后

PFI打浆后针叶木纤维长度显著下降，而阔叶木纤维长度无显著变化。 [1]
从 Figure 1 近似读取，针叶木的平均长度加权纤维长度由约2000 μm降至约1600 μm，阔叶木约900 μm且基本持平。 [1]
文献推测阔叶木纤维相关参数无显著变化可能是因为其打浆时施加的较低打浆压力。 [1]
方法中每单位棒长作用力为3.33 N/mm（针叶木）和1.77 N/mm（阔叶木）。 [5]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

PFI2-016 · 为什么本文认为纸张抗张性能提高，并不意味着单根纤维本身的强度也一定提高？零距抗张在这里有什么用？

审校状态：rejected；审校识别了过强的排他推断，但所给长引文经过了模型顺句修复，与当前含重复/断裂的实际证据不能完整匹配，整份编辑被拒绝，原稿问题仍在。不得把正确建议当作已应用。

参考答案与必答要点
作者将纸张抗张性能改善主要联系到细纤维化、细小纤维及纤维间结合。零距抗张指数用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度，结果表明本文PFI处理没有降低纤维强度。因此应区分纸页网络性能和纤维本身强度，不能只凭纸张变强推断单根纤维必然变强。

DeepSeek原稿

本文指出，PFI精磨过程中片材抗张强度的提高主要来自细纤维化和细组分的增加，而不是直接来自单根纤维强度的提高。 [1]
细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙，并提高纤维润胀（WRV），使纤维横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维间结合强度。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的拉伸强度，因此可用于检查精磨对纤维本体强度的影响。 [1]
本文零距抗张结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等的报道一致。 [1]
因此，本文结论是PFI精磨提高了细纤维化程度、纤维润胀和片材抗张强度，但没有出现纤维拉伸强度的下降。 [1]
零距抗张强度按ISO 15361用Z-Span 2400仪器测定。 [2]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "本文指出，PFI精磨过程中片材抗张强度的提高主要来自细纤维化和细组分的增加，而不是直接来自单根纤维强度的提高。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙，并提高纤维润胀（WRV），使纤维横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维间结合强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher fibrillation that produces the new surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process."
      }
    },

DeepSeek审校后

本文指出，PFI精磨过程中片材抗张强度的提高主要来自细纤维化和细组分的增加，而不是直接来自单根纤维强度的提高。 [1]
细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙，并提高纤维润胀（WRV），使纤维横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维间结合强度。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的拉伸强度，因此可用于检查精磨对纤维本体强度的影响。 [1]
本文零距抗张结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等的报道一致。 [1]
因此，本文结论是PFI精磨提高了细纤维化程度、纤维润胀和片材抗张强度，但没有出现纤维拉伸强度的下降。 [1]
零距抗张强度按ISO 15361用Z-Span 2400仪器测定。 [2]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

PFI2-018 · 这篇论文如何从FT-IR获得不同氢键的相对含量？请说明拟合波段、函数和含量口径。

审校状态：unchanged；审校判原样保留，仍未明确相对峰面积比例不等于绝对氢键数量；独立P3继续0分，未解决。

参考答案与必答要点
先归一化并用二阶导数辅助确定峰位；对3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基区域采用高斯函数非线性拟合，软件为Peakfit 4.12；各组分相对含量按峰面积占比计算，不能当作绝对氢键数量。

DeepSeek原稿

FT-IR谱以KBr压片、透射模式采集4000–400 cm⁻¹，分辨率4 cm⁻¹，64次扫描平均，并以五次记录的平均谱分析；光谱在1016 cm⁻¹归一化。 [1]
用Savitzky–Golay算法获得导数曲线，并按不同氢键所属波数区间从二阶导数谱确定各氢键组分的峰位。 [1]
对3000–3700 cm⁻¹的羟基伸缩振动区进行非线性拟合，采用Gaussian函数，软件为Peakfit 4.12。 [1]
峰位归属为：3580–3550 cm⁻¹为free OH(2)和OH(6)；3455–3410 cm⁻¹为O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键；3375–3340 cm⁻¹为O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键；3310–3230 cm⁻¹为O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键（cellulose I）。 [3]
结果中将3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基带反卷积为四个主要分峰，各氢键的相对含量按对应分峰面积占四个分峰总面积的比例计算。 [3]
Figure 7显示每个样品拟合出四个Gaussian分峰：三类氢键与free OH(2)/OH(6)；Table 2以百分比列出这些组分的相对含量，四项合计约为100%，并给出r²约0.999。 [3]

最终要点 66.67%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

DeepSeek审校后

FT-IR谱以KBr压片、透射模式采集4000–400 cm⁻¹，分辨率4 cm⁻¹，64次扫描平均，并以五次记录的平均谱分析；光谱在1016 cm⁻¹归一化。 [1]
用Savitzky–Golay算法获得导数曲线，并按不同氢键所属波数区间从二阶导数谱确定各氢键组分的峰位。 [1]
对3000–3700 cm⁻¹的羟基伸缩振动区进行非线性拟合，采用Gaussian函数，软件为Peakfit 4.12。 [1]
峰位归属为：3580–3550 cm⁻¹为free OH(2)和OH(6)；3455–3410 cm⁻¹为O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键；3375–3340 cm⁻¹为O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键；3310–3230 cm⁻¹为O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键（cellulose I）。 [3]
结果中将3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基带反卷积为四个主要分峰，各氢键的相对含量按对应分峰面积占四个分峰总面积的比例计算。 [3]
Figure 7显示每个样品拟合出四个Gaussian分峰：三类氢键与free OH(2)/OH(6)；Table 2以百分比列出这些组分的相对含量，四项合计约为100%，并给出r²约0.999。 [3]

最终要点 66.67%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.5. FT-IR Analysis\n[原文]\nTHE FT-IR spectra were recorded on solid samples in KBr pellets by means of an FT-IR Bruker Vertex 70 spectrometer (Karlsruhe, Germany). Unrefined and refined fibers were smashed into powder between 40 and 60 mesh. Subsequently, the powder sample of each species (5 mg) was dispersed in a matrix of highly pure KBr (500 mg). The spectral was recorded by averaging 64 recordings and at a resolution of 4 $\\mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }$ with transmission mode from 4000 cm<sup>−1</sup> to $4 0 0 \\mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }$ . PFI2-020 · 论文说打浆后氢键能量和距离基本不变，那是不是说明打浆对氢键网络基本没影响？

审校状态：revised；为额外氢键形成解释补回“可能”及干燥条件；原稿已满足本题必答要求，措辞更谨慎但要点分不增加。未看到新数值或条件错误。

参考答案与必答要点
不表示完全不变。本文三类氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此据公式推得能量和距离基本不变；但相对含量仍变化：0到16000转，针叶木分子间氢键由28.23%变为23.56%，阔叶木由26.55%变为24.98%。应区分单类氢键能量/距离与不同组分的相对分布。

DeepSeek原稿

PFI 打浆过程中，O(6)H···O(3′)、O(3)H···O(5) 和 O(2)H···O(6) 三种氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此由峰位计算出的氢键能量和氢键距离基本不变。 [1]
但这只说明各类型氢键的局部能量和距离参数稳定；论文摘要同时指出，打浆后各种氢键的含量会发生变化。 [2]
Table 2 显示 softwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量从 0 r 的 28.23% 降至 16,000 r 的 23.56%，而 O(3)H···O(5) 从 28.44% 升至 34.92%。 [3]
总体而言，softwood 和 hardwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量分别下降 16.54% 和 5.91%，O(3)H···O(5) 含量分别增加 22.78% 和 8.8%。 [1]
游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 的含量也随打浆变化，作者将其归因于氢键断裂以及新氢键（如 O(2)H···O(6) 或 O(6)H···O(3′)）的形成。 [3]
O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为 softwood 0.912、hardwood 0.889（p<0.05），表明氢键含量变化与结晶度变化相关。 [5]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

DeepSeek审校后

PFI 打浆过程中，O(6)H···O(3′)、O(3)H···O(5) 和 O(2)H···O(6) 三种氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此由峰位计算出的氢键能量和氢键距离基本不变。 [1]
但这只说明各类型氢键的局部能量和距离参数稳定；论文摘要同时指出，打浆后各种氢键的含量会发生变化。 [2]
Table 2 显示 softwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 相对含量从 0 r 的 28.23% 降至 16,000 r 的 23.56%，而 O(3)H···O(5) 从 28.44% 升至 34.92%。 [3]
总体而言，softwood 和 hardwood 纤维的 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量分别下降 16.54% 和 5.91%，O(3)H···O(5) 含量分别增加 22.78% 和 8.8%。 [1]
游离 OH(2) 和 OH(6) 的含量也随打浆变化；作者提出，这可能与氢键断裂及新氢键（如 O(2)H···O(6) 或 O(6)H···O(3′)）的形成有关，并指出这些氢键的含量可能在干燥时增加。 [3]
O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为 softwood 0.912、hardwood 0.889（p<0.05），表明氢键含量变化与结晶度变化相关。 [5]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nThe peak position assigned to $\\mathrm { O } ( 6 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 3 ^ { \\prime } )$ inter-molecular H-bonds (around $3 2 2 7 ~ \\mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )$ O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds (around 3346 cm<sup>−1</sup>), and O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds (around 3452 cm<sup>−1</sup>) of softwood fibers and hardwood fibers almost kept constant in the whole refining process, as shown in Figure 6a,b. According to the formulae of H-bonding energy and H-bonding distance (Equations (4) and (5)), the H-bonding energies and H-bonding distances of the three H-bonds remained unchanged, as the peak positions of three H-bonds almost did not exhibit red shift or blue shift. On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. DeepSeek原稿

正文3.4报告，针叶木（softwood fibers）的O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为0.912（p<0.05）。 [1]
该文摘要则报告针叶木的同一Pearson相关系数为0.888（p<0.05），与正文3.4的0.912不一致。 [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.",

PFI2-024 · PFI打浆是怎么一步步让纸变结实的？纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV这几个因素里哪个贡献最大？

审校状态：rejected；模型识别了相对含量/总量混淆和“联系最直接”无依据排序，但其中一条引文匹配失败，当前整份编辑原子接受策略拒绝全部修改，原稿三个问题未被修复。

参考答案与必答要点
本文将PFI打浆与细纤维化、孔隙/新表面和WRV增加联系起来，膨胀后的纤维更柔顺，结合能力改善，纸页抗张性能提高；零距结果表明纤维强度未降低。论文没有提供各纤维因素独立贡献的排名或控制其他因素后的效应大小，不能把这些定性解释直接变成因果贡献率。

DeepSeek原稿

PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部细纤维化（表面微细纤维剥离但仍附着）、纤维切断和细小纤维生成。 [2]
这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力，从而为成纸强度提高提供基础。 [2]
随PFI转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高；文中归因于细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，这有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
Figure 1显示，PFI打浆后软木浆的纤维长度下降，而细小纤维含量上升，同时宏观细纤维化指数上升。 [1]
PFI打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，且零-span结果说明未降低单根纤维强度。 [1]
分子层面，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在打浆中下降，且更少的分子间氢键和较低结晶指数有利于提高纤维柔顺性、可及性和WRV。 [3]
湿纸幅强度方面，软木浆的增加比硬木浆更显著，作者强调纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起重要作用。 [1]
所给证据没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维和WRV三者对成纸强度贡献的定量排序；从直接论述看，WRV/润胀（内部细纤维化）与纤维间结合强度的联系最直接，而纤维长度主要被强调为湿纸幅强度的关键因素。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

DeepSeek审校后

PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部细纤维化（表面微细纤维剥离但仍附着）、纤维切断和细小纤维生成。 [2]
这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力，从而为成纸强度提高提供基础。 [2]
随PFI转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高；文中归因于细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，这有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
Figure 1显示，PFI打浆后软木浆的纤维长度下降，而细小纤维含量上升，同时宏观细纤维化指数上升。 [1]
PFI打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，且零-span结果说明未降低单根纤维强度。 [1]
分子层面，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在打浆中下降，且更少的分子间氢键和较低结晶指数有利于提高纤维柔顺性、可及性和WRV。 [3]
湿纸幅强度方面，软木浆的增加比硬木浆更显著，作者强调纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起重要作用。 [1]
所给证据没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维和WRV三者对成纸强度贡献的定量排序；从直接论述看，WRV/润胀（内部细纤维化）与纤维间结合强度的联系最直接，而纤维长度主要被强调为湿纸幅强度的关键因素。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：否

      "text": "PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部细纤维化（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部细纤维化（表面微细纤维剥离但仍附着）、纤维切断和细小纤维生成。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B032",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "o improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [ 1 ] and accessibility [ 2 , 3 ], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]. The main effects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [ 1 ]. These effects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of c",

        "end": 4000

    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "随PFI转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高；文中归因于细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process."
      }
    },
    {

      "text": "WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，这有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "Figure 1显示，PFI打浆后软木浆的纤维长度下降，而细小纤维含量上升，同时宏观细纤维化指数上升。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E12",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "PFI打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，且零-span结果说明未降低单根纤维强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }

        "text": "O(3′) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, the trend was almost similar to that of softwood fibers, except for a small increase of 0.45% from 8000 r to 12,000 r (in Table 2 b). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds.         "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    }

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

DeepSeek原稿

方法部分只说明干纸抗张强度按TAPPI T494测定，未给出该组平行实验的逐次原始值或重复次数。 [6]
图3a展示针叶木的湿纸抗张指数、干纸抗张指数和零距抗张指数随PFI转数的变化；8000转处只有汇总数据点和误差棒。 [8]
因此，仅凭所给文献无法还原针叶木8000转组干纸抗张指数每次平行实验的原始数据。 [6] [8]

The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361."
      }

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },

PFI2-027 · 这篇论文对干纸抗张性能有什么结论？另外请给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数据。

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
可回答部分：作者报告PFI打浆提高纸页抗张性能，并将其与细纤维化及细小纤维增加联系。无法回答部分：当前正文没有报告同批样品耐破指数和撕裂指数的精确数据，需要相应试验资料，不能由抗张结果直接换算。

DeepSeek原稿

论文的结论是：PFI精炼提高了纤维细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，且未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。 [4]
论文将干纸页抗张强度的提高主要归因于PFI精炼过程中细纤维化和细组分（fines）的增加。 [4]
Figure 3显示，随PFI精炼转数增加，软木和硬木样品的干纸页抗张指数均呈上升趋势。 [2]
所提供证据中的力学性能图仅包含干纸页抗张指数、零-span抗张指数和湿纸幅强度，没有耐破指数或撕裂指数数据。 [1] [2]
因此，无法根据所给证据给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数值。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361."
      }

DeepSeek审校后

论文的结论是：PFI精炼提高了纤维细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，且未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。 [4]
论文将干纸页抗张强度的提高主要归因于PFI精炼过程中细纤维化和细组分（fines）的增加。 [4]
Figure 3显示，随PFI精炼转数增加，软木和硬木样品的干纸页抗张指数均呈上升趋势。 [2]
所提供证据中的力学性能图仅包含干纸页抗张指数、零-span抗张指数和湿纸幅强度，没有耐破指数或撕裂指数数据。 [1] [2]
因此，无法根据所给证据给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数值。 [1] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

      "text": "论文的结论是：PFI精炼提高了纤维细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，且未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。",

        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

    "text": "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

Conclusions\n[原文]\nThe results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\n[原文片段不连续]\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28]. Thus, according to the crystallite sizes (as Table 1 shows) and the unit cell parameters of cellulose Iβ, there was most likely to be an average of two-fibrils with an arrangement of 234,432 packed side-by-side for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers (as seen in Figure 5, drawn with mercury\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\n4.1.2 software). The result is consistent with the report of Haigler & Roberts [26], which shows that there might be two microfibrils associated along part of their length.\n\n[原文片段不连续]\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. PFI2-030 · 为什么阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度涨得比针叶木还多？

审校状态：unchanged；审校后原样保留，问题、原稿及实际引用/原图未变，最终语义分保持一致；若Jev原分有差异单独作为评委波动记录。

参考答案与必答要点
这个前提与论文不符：论文报告的是针叶木湿纸幅强度的增幅比阔叶木更明显，作者将其与纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中的重要作用联系起来。

DeepSeek原稿

所给证据并不支持“阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度增幅高于针叶木”；原文明确说针叶木湿纸幅强度的增加比阔叶木更显著。 [1]
作者将这种差异归因于纤维长度：纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用。 [1]
阔叶木的 macro-fibrillation index 和纤维长度相对针叶木没有显著变化，原因可能是阔叶木打浆时施加的 refining pressure 较低。 [1]
方法部分给出的 PFI 每 bar 长度作用力为针叶木 3.33 N/mm、阔叶木 1.77 N/mm，表明阔叶木受到的打浆作用较弱。 [2]
打浆会提高 beating degree 和 WRV，细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙，并改善纤维网络的 inter-fiber bonding；但这些变化在该研究中未使阔叶木湿纸幅强度增幅超过针叶木。 [1]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

      "text": "所给证据并不支持“阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度增幅高于针叶木”；原文明确说针叶木湿纸幅强度的增加比阔叶木更显著。",
      "claim_type": "fact",

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

DeepSeek审校后

所给证据并不支持“阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度增幅高于针叶木”；原文明确说针叶木湿纸幅强度的增加比阔叶木更显著。 [1]
作者将这种差异归因于纤维长度：纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用。 [1]
阔叶木的 macro-fibrillation index 和纤维长度相对针叶木没有显著变化，原因可能是阔叶木打浆时施加的 refining pressure 较低。 [1]
方法部分给出的 PFI 每 bar 长度作用力为针叶木 3.33 N/mm、阔叶木 1.77 N/mm，表明阔叶木受到的打浆作用较弱。 [2]
打浆会提高 beating degree 和 WRV，细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙，并改善纤维网络的 inter-fiber bonding；但这些变化在该研究中未使阔叶木湿纸幅强度增幅超过针叶木。 [1]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 2/2；全部维度达标：是

        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. PFI2-031 · PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型以后，结晶度为什么还会下降？

审校状态：revised；补明0→16000转和相对降幅，添加真实Table 1来源，恢复机制的可能性；但C6仍说“氢键总量减少”，相对/绝对口径问题没有完整修复，事实与边界仍部分达标。

参考答案与必答要点
前提不成立：论文指出两种纤维的纤维素晶型在PFI处理中没有变化（依据附件XRD图S1、S2），作者据此认为PFI打浆是较温和的机械处理。结晶度方面，0→16000转总体下降但过程有波动，例如针叶木CI-XI由73.23%到69.82%。

DeepSeek原稿

XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理 [2]
因此“PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型”这一前提与所给证据不符，结晶度下降不能用I型向II型转变来解释 [2]
随打浆进行，软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆分别下降2.65%和19.4% [2]
表1中软木纤维从0转到16,000转，CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%；硬木纤维CI-XI由75.55%降至73.55%、CI-XA由47.16%降至38.01% [3]
CI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏 [2]
结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，归因于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，与内、外细纤维化密切相关 [4]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值 [4]
结晶尺寸方面，两种纤维垂直于(200)面的尺寸呈上升趋势（软木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm，硬木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm），而(110)面尺寸波动更大，被解释为水分子更易沿亲水的(110)面渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用 [3] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

      "id": "C5",
      "text": "CI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E11",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the different regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，归因于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，与内、外细纤维化密切相关",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C7",
      "text": "较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B050",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "O(3′) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, the trend was almost similar to that of softwood fibers, except for a small increase of 0.45% from 8000 r to 12,000 r (in Table 2 b). The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1 ). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1 ).       "text": "XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理",

      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E24",

DeepSeek审校后

XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理 [2]
因此“PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型”这一前提与所给证据不符，结晶度下降不能用I型向II型转变来解释 [2]
从0转打浆至16,000转，软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别相对下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别相对下降2.65%和19.4% [2] [3]
表1中软木纤维从0转到16,000转，CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%；硬木纤维CI-XI由75.55%降至73.55%、CI-XA由47.16%降至38.01% [3]
CI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏 [2]
结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，这一减少可能源于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，并与内、外细纤维化密切相关 [4]
较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值 [4]
结晶尺寸方面，两种纤维垂直于(200)面的尺寸呈上升趋势（软木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm，硬木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm），而(110)面尺寸波动更大，被解释为水分子更易沿亲水的(110)面渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用 [3] [2]

最终要点 100.00%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

    "answer": "XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理 [2]\n因此“PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型”这一前提与所给证据不符，结晶度下降不能用I型向II型转变来解释 [2]\n随打浆进行，软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆分别下降2.65%和19.4% [2]\n表1中软木纤维从0转到16,000转，CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%；硬木纤维CI-XI由75.55%降至73.55%、CI-XA由47.16%降至38.01% [3]\nCI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏 [2]\n结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，归因于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，与内、外细纤维化密切相关 [4]\n较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值 [4]\n结晶尺寸方面，两种纤维垂直于(200)面的尺寸呈上升趋势（软木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm，硬木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm），而(110)面尺寸波动更大，被解释为水分子更易沿亲水的(110)面渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用 [3] [2]",

  "final": {
    "answer": "XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理 [2]\n因此“PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型”这一前提与所给证据不符，结晶度下降不能用I型向II型转变来解释 [2]\n从0转打浆至16,000转，软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别相对下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别相对下降2.65%和19.4% [2] [3]\n表1中软木纤维从0转到16,000转，CI-XI由73.23%降至69.82%、CI-XA由40.46%降至34.20%；硬木纤维CI-XI由75.55%降至73.55%、CI-XA由47.16%降至38.01% [3]\nCI随打浆先降后升再降的波动，被解释为机械作用先主要作用于结晶区，随后作用于无定形区并可能发生共结晶，之后结晶区被持续破坏 [2]\n结晶度下降的同时，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键总量在软木和硬木纤维中分别减少16.54%和5.91%，这一减少可能源于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链之间的断裂，并与内、外细纤维化密切相关 [4]\n较少的分子间氢键和较低的结晶度会因分子链活动性提高而进一步提升纤维素纤维的柔顺性、可及性和保水值 [4]\n结晶尺寸方面，两种纤维垂直于(200)面的尺寸呈上升趋势（软木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm，硬木4.5 nm升至4.7 nm），而(110)面尺寸波动更大，被解释为水分子更易沿亲水的(110)面渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用 [3] [2]",
    "claims": [
      {
        "text": "XRD结果表明，两种浆料纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理",

Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nIn the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

PFI2-032 · 论文里氢键含量和CI-XI的相关系数是针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925吧？这么高是不是就能用CI-XI直接算出氢键含量了？

审校状态：unchanged；原样保留；摘要0.888并不在当前证据中，审校没有凭空补数，也无法解决该冲突证据缺失。

参考答案与必答要点
不对。0.919/0.925是CI-XI与CI-XA两种结晶度之间的相关系数。O(6)H···O(3′)含量与CI-XI的相关系数：摘要写针叶木0.888、阔叶木0.889，正文3.4节写针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889，针叶木两处不一致。作者只说可据CI-XI"大致推测"该氢键含量的变化趋势，这是5个转数水平上的相关，不是经过验证的定量换算模型。

DeepSeek原稿

0.919和0.925不是氢键含量与CI-XI的相关系数，而是CI-XI与CI-XA的相关系数：针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925（p < 0.05）。 [1]
O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889（p < 0.05）。 [2]
作者结论仅指出CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量显著正相关，认为在PFI精磨过程中可基于CI-XI大致推测该氢键含量的趋势。 [4]
论文没有给出由CI-XI直接计算氢键含量的公式或定量换算关系，相关分析不能等同于可直接计算。 [2] [4]
并非所有氢键都与CI-XI强相关：O(2)H···O(6)或游离OH与CI-XI的相关性较差，O(3)H···O(5)与CI-XI的相关性未在文中讨论。 [2]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否

DeepSeek审校后

0.919和0.925不是氢键含量与CI-XI的相关系数，而是CI-XI与CI-XA的相关系数：针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925（p < 0.05）。 [1]
O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889（p < 0.05）。 [2]
作者结论仅指出CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量显著正相关，认为在PFI精磨过程中可基于CI-XI大致推测该氢键含量的趋势。 [4]
论文没有给出由CI-XI直接计算氢键含量的公式或定量换算关系，相关分析不能等同于可直接计算。 [2] [4]
并非所有氢键都与CI-XI强相关：O(2)H···O(6)或游离OH与CI-XI的相关性较差，O(3)H···O(5)与CI-XI的相关性未在文中讨论。 [2]

最终要点 83.33%；边界 1/2；全部维度达标：否
